system.description:
You release two thick cords of silk, binding them to a nearby surface as you drag your body against it until it can’t handle the strain, before letting yourself go, and being launched in a straight line like a missile in a direction of your choice, up to 90 feet, landing in a space that can hold you, otherwise falling prone.

This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks, and if you would cross a creature as part of this movement, you can come crashing down on them, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw and ending your movement within 5 feet of them. On a failure, they fall prone and you deal your [Weapon Damage] (or [Unarmed Damage]) + 1d12.

Alternatively, when you cast this jutsu, you can target one willing allied creature within 5 feet of you, having them benefit from this jutsu as if they cast it.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d12. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the range of this jutsu by +30 feet.
